correctness.rationale: Bertoin Theorem 4.1 is correctly specialized with a_j=j-1 and A_j=sum_{r=1}^j(r-1)^2; uniform for k<=bn for any fixed b>0. Eq. (5.6) gives sqrt(k) P_k(R_k>floor(k t)) -> sqrt(6/[pi((1+t)^3-1)]). For n>=k the uniform asymptotic gives O(k n^-3/2) and for n<k a monotone coupling to simple symmetric excursions gives O(n^-1/2), providing integrable tail domination, finite mu(k) and the beta integral constant. Geometric positive excursions before a negative jump and Jensen control of successive epochs preserve the same mean asymptotic. Direct urn transition probabilities give S_s=F_{s-1}-1 and T=H_2-1. Independent exact rational DP verified shift through 42 and beta constant 3.3563383598. The infinite result uses the cited theorem and rigorous summability, not this finite test.
